# Pantheon of One

**Version 2.8** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3811559970) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=pantheon-of-one&expanded=true)

Play as a god. Not a king with a halo: a god whose power is the worship of the
faithful, and whose gifts to them are overwhelming but never permanent.

You don't need to conquer the world. You need it to pray to you.

---

## Becoming a god

1. Take the decision **Ascend to Godhood**. You become **Divine**:
  immortal, untouched by disease or wounds, +30 to every skill, +100 prowess.
  No hostile scheme against you can succeed, no prison can hold you, and religion
  costs you nothing.
1. Open **the Pantheon**: the new button above your portrait, or right-click
  yourself and choose **Divine Will**.
1. *Optional:* to be worshipped under your own name, create a branched
  rite in the Religion screen (free for a god), then **Proclaim Your
  Divinity**: it becomes a faith of its own.
1. **Take the Throne** (The God tab). You become the living, independent Head
  of your faith, ruling from an impregnable **Holy Seat**.

**Divine Offspring:** forswear mortal children, or let your children be born
**Demigods**: gifted, beautiful and brilliant, legitimate, though mortal.
**Divine Conception** (in Bless) lets you father (or bear) a demigod with any
follower, as an honour, never a scandal. Your divine **Guardians** keep raiders from the Holy Seat.

---

## Worship and Devotion

Every season, Worship flows to you from every county and every ruler of your
faith. Every follower has a **Devotion**: the devout give twice as much and
never leave you; the wavering give nothing, and may turn to another faith. A god
with no other ruler of the faith starts with 600 Worship.

## At a glance

Every ruler of your faith carries a **Follower** trait in the full character view: Zealous to Lapsing, a Devotion bar, and a gold diamond while they wait on you. Its text names what they wait on. Menus highlight what waits; Bless shows what suits.

**Follower alerts:** hear when a follower is about to leave (Lapsing) or has left, in the message feed or the top bar, as you choose by rank (Followers tab, Alerts). A Lost list keeps who left.

## Winning the faithful

Belief is hard to keep: below 90, Devotion slowly dwindles, and followers blame you for misfortunes (a death, a lost war, a cell, illness). To win unbelievers without spending Worship, set out on a **Godhood tour** (The God tab) to plant a seed of belief, then begin a **work** on a lord of another faith in seeded land, by fear or by kindness. A won work converts the lord and pays Worship; seeded counties slowly turn on their own.

## Prayers

Your followers pray to you when they are in need: for the Host in a losing
war, for children, a spouse, healing, long life, protection from plague,
relief from debt (and a harvest, if they hold land), a divine gift, or freedom from a foreign prison; their kin pray for a jailed loved one. **Grant** it, **send a sign**, or
**refuse**, now or later from the Prayers tab, and their Devotion follows. Strangers may pray too, and follow you if you help them. Game rule: Prayer Frequency.

---

## Wrath

Right-click an enemy of your faith, an apostate, or a sinner among your
followers:

- **Pass Judgement**: strike them down, maim, blind or wound them, or curse them
- **Wrath upon their lands**: choose one of their counties, then Pestilence,
  The Great Dying (a plague that will spread, perhaps to your own), or a Disaster
  that brings a building down

A sin weighs less than a crime: sinners can only be cursed or maimed. Your
devout are never judged. And when an infidel makes war on your devout or your
holy sites, or anyone makes war on you, **Divine Retribution** asks how you
answer.

## Great Prayers

Your most devout remember who wronged them: a murdered kinsman, a war lost to
an unbeliever, a holy site seized, a cell, a torturer. In time they beg you for
vengeance. **Swear it** and strike, and they are yours forever, with a
thank-offering and the awe of the whole faith. Refuse, and they remember; swear and stay your hand, and they never forgive.

## Your Children

Your demigod children are your instruments. **Lend** one to a faithful
ruler's court for ten years, as champion, councillor or commander; or **wed**
one into their house, so their children carry your blood. **Reveal** the blood and the whole house is Godsblooded, their dynasty exalted. **Free** one from another
ruler's prison, or **dissolve** a match gone sour and bring them home.

---

## The Pantheon

One window for your whole faith. **Followers** lists every ruler who worships
you, with their skills, Devotion and blessings. **Prayers** holds what awaits your answer; an alert reminds you. **Children**
shows your demigods and the houses of your blood. **The God** holds your throne,
your Worship and your oaths.

Every power is a right-click action showing its price and why it can't be used. **Bless** a follower with:

- **A divine gift**, for five years: Champion, Warlord, Sovereign or Sage
- **Bless their lands**, for ten years: a bountiful harvest, unbreachable
  walls, or warding from plague
- **Bless their life**: divine vigor (no aging), divine fertility, or a
  blessed lineage (their next child is born a beautiful genius)
- **The Host of Heaven**: an army of overwhelming divine soldiers descends
  to fight in one of their wars

A notice tells you when a boon fades (a game rule).

---

## Game rule: Divine Economy

- **Earned Godhood** (default): Worship flows modestly and boons are costly.
- **Sandbox God**: Worship flows five times faster, boons cost a quarter,
  and they last twice as long.

## Great Boons

Your most devout followers ask for the impossible, and you can answer:

- **Raise my house** (4,800 Worship): the crown above them, theirs at once
- **Save my dying kin** (2,400): an ill or wounded heir, spouse or child healed, with Vigor
- **Win this holy war** (4,800): the war they're losing ends in their victory
- **Give me an heir** (2,400): a child born to them alone, of your faith
- **Bring the land to the faith** (3,600): their whole domain converts
- **Restore my fortune** (1,800): their debt wiped and their coffers refilled

They ask in prayer, or you grant it unasked (twice the awe). Refuse, and they lose Devotion.

## The Great Temple

A wonder only a god can raise: five tiers (Shrine, Sanctuary, Temple, High Temple, Great Temple), founded on a holy site of your faith or your capital. Each tier costs Worship and years, and compounds the last: more Worship, cheaper boons, a stronger Host, Devotion for followers around it. If its county leaves faithful hands, its powers sleep.

At the Great Temple, four miracles await, one at a time:

- **Mass conversion**: every county for miles around takes your faith at once
- **Age of faith**: for years, Worship doubles and your followers' Devotion swells
- **Divine victory**: every war your followers lead against an unbeliever ends in their favour
- **The Wrath of Heaven**: disaster, plague and fear fall on a huge swath of the world around any ruler you choose, sparing your own domain

---

For Crusader Kings III 1.20. Compatible with most mods: it adds its own content
and replaces nothing.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `pantheon-of-one-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=pantheon-of-one&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
